verdict.rationale: Gide's Venture & Growth Tech page says it supports 'both investors and entrepreneurs' across all stages and advises 'entrepreneurs and investors' on financing documentation from seed to IPO. That two-sided practice is backed by volume of more than 70 transactions a year, and the firm-hosted Chambers Band 1 quote praises its 'very good understanding of market practices'. missing for 10: named fund or investor-side deal references, independently sourced corroboration beyond the firm's own site, and any published market-terms data or benchmarks.
